# Feature: Project Management, Tags, and Board Filtering

## Overview
Extend the React Kanban board with project creation and deletion, project assignment in task create/edit flows, project tags on every associated task card, and toggles that filter visible tasks by enabled projects. Keep the existing single-board workflow and native drag-and-drop behavior.

## User Stories
- As an Admin user, I want to create or delete a project from the app.
- As an Admin user, I want to assign a task to any number of projects or no project.
- As an Admin user, I want to see every project associated with a task as a tag.
- As an Admin user, I want to toggle projects on or off so only tasks under enabled projects are shown.

## Implementation Plan

### UI Components
- `client/src/components/Navbar.jsx`: Add a compact project control area or project management entry point without requiring a separate route; preserve theme and existing task actions.
- `client/src/components/ProjectManager.jsx`: Render project list, on/off toggles, create form, delete actions, empty state, and loading/error states.
- `client/src/components/TaskCard.jsx`: Render one accessible project tag per associated project; do not render a placeholder tag for unassigned tasks.
- `client/src/components/TaskModal.jsx`: Add a multi-select project control that supports assigning zero or many projects during create and edit.
- `client/src/components/KanbanBoard.jsx`: Load projects, track enabled project IDs, and derive visible tasks without mutating the canonical task collection.
- `client/src/services/api.js`: Add project CRUD calls and task payload support for `project_ids`.
- `client/src/index.css`: Style tags, toggle states, project controls, and responsive overflow while matching the existing light/dark theme variables.

### Data Model (Mock)
```js
const projects = [
  { id: 1, name: "Website refresh" },
  { id: 3, name: "Launch checklist" },
]

const task = {
  id: 42,
  title: "Review homepage copy",
  project_ids: [1, 3],
  projects: [
    { id: 1, name: "Website refresh" },
    { id: 3, name: "Launch checklist" },
  ],
}
```

Filtering rule: when no project toggles are enabled, show all tasks, including unassigned tasks. When one or more projects are enabled, show a task if its project IDs intersect the enabled IDs; unassigned tasks are hidden in that filtered state.

### Simulated Backend
Use the existing service layer with `GET /api/projects/`, `POST /api/projects/`, and `DELETE /api/projects/{id}/`. Refresh or reconcile local project state after mutations. Send `project_ids` in task create/update requests and use the API-provided `projects` summaries for tags. Frontend development may use the sample objects above until the backend endpoint is available.

### Step-by-Step Implementation
1. Extend `client/src/services/api.js` with `fetchProjects`, `createProject`, `deleteProject`, and task save support for `project_ids`.
2. Add `ProjectManager.jsx` and integrate it into `Navbar.jsx` or the board header so project controls are available on the main view.
3. Add project state and derived filtering in `KanbanBoard.jsx`; ensure drag-and-drop status updates continue to operate on the full task list, not only the filtered projection.
4. Add a multi-project selector to `TaskModal.jsx`, initializing edits from the task’s current project IDs and allowing an empty selection.
5. Add project tags to `TaskCard.jsx` with stable sizing and accessible names; handle long names without breaking card layout.
6. Add focused component/service tests or repository-appropriate checks for create/delete controls, toggle filtering, unassigned-task behavior, multi-project tags, and project deletion refresh behavior.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Users can create a project from the main app and see it in the project controls.
- [ ] Users can delete a project without deleting its tasks; deleted project tags disappear after refresh/reconciliation.
- [ ] Users can toggle any project on or off.
- [ ] With no enabled projects, all tasks are shown, including tasks with no project.
- [ ] With enabled projects, only tasks belonging to at least one enabled project are shown.
- [ ] Task cards show one tag per associated project and no tag when unassigned.
- [ ] Task create/edit supports zero or many project assignments.
- [ ] Existing task status drag-and-drop and theme behavior remain intact.
- [ ] Layout remains usable on narrow screens and project names do not overlap other controls.

## Dependencies
- **Internal**: Existing React Kanban components, task modal, service layer, and theme variables. Backend response contract is defined in Feature 1, but UI work can proceed with the mock data contract.
- **External**: Existing React/Vite dependencies; use the existing icon library if project controls need icons. No routing package is required because controls live in the header/board view.
